text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Have you decided on which chocolate you'd 
like? If you'd like, I can recommend some 
chocolates based on your personal tastes.

While browsing the Valentine's event on my 
day off, Mihono Bourbon called out to me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...I deeply apologize. I had completely 
forgotten to report to Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Currently executing Operation: Guide at 
this event.
choice_data_list: So you mean a part-time job?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Contractually speaking, that is the case. 
To explain in detail—"

"Apparently, the staff's arrival was 
delayed by traffic, so Eishin Flash is 
helping out at an acquaintance's shop."

Mihono Bourbon ran into her here by chance 
and was asked to help out for a temporary 
part-time gig. Since she's indebted to her 
on a regular basis, she apparently 
accepted.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is a valuable mission to acquire 
useful knowledge and war funds for 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master, would you permit me to work a 
part-time job for just one day?
choice_data_list:
Got it. I'll report it to the academy as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~, do you have any truffles from 
the Valentine's limited selection~?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please let me know your preferred 
flavor.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I think it'd be nice if it's on the 
sweeter side so we can enjoy a bunch of 
different flavors~.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Search complete. I recommend that shop 
over there. The ganache is smooth, and 
when it melts, a rich milk flavor fills 
your mouth.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The shop next door offers a wide variety 
of flavors. It's the only place where you 
can find such juicy and aromatic truffles 
made with real fruit juice.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, you know so much, miss!! Alright, 
I'll go check that shop out~!

Who knew Mihono Bourbon was so good at 
food reviews? Quite an unexpected 
discovery. Did she sample every single 
shop? I can really feel her passion for 
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I'm late! Thank you so much for your 
help! I'll take over the rest, so please 
go ahead and clock out!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Mission complete. Thank you 
for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, Bourbon-san. 
I'm truly grateful for everything today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
By the way, do you have some time after 
this? Let me treat you to some cake as a 
thank-you for today. Please, Trainer, come 
join us too.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cake...? ...No, there's no need to thank 
me. I've already received my pay for the 
part-time work...
choice_data_list:
No need for thanks—let's just eat 
together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
! That won't be a problem at all...! Cake 
order for three, coming right up.

The three of them came to a nearby café. 
Mihono Bourbon and Eishin Flash ordered 
the Valentine's limited-edition chocolate 
cake.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's only January, everywhere 
you look is covered in Valentine's 
displays. I'm certainly not complaining 
about getting to taste all kinds of 
chocolate, though.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Around this time of year, my friends 
always come over asking me to teach them 
how to make chocolate sweets."
choice_data_list:
Are you preparing for Valentine's Day 
already?

You're already preparing for Valentine's 
Day, huh.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Those unaccustomed to making 
sweets tend to practice several times.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...There are items requiring verification 
under 'handmade'. Flash-san, a question 
for you."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to homemade, there's no way 
it can beat the flavor of a professional 
chocolatier's.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"It seems important to have that extra 
little something not found in 
off-the-shelf products. What would be 
appropriate to add?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The extra something... might be making it 
with all your heart, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching... Zero results found. How 
should one give form to "feelings"?
choice_data_list:
The time you spent agonizing shows just 
how much you care.

text_block_list.text:
I explain that the time spent wondering 
and agonizing over what chocolates to give 
while thinking of the recipient is itself 
an expression of one's "feelings."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Baking sweets takes time and effort. 
Because you put all that care into making 
them without cutting corners, I'm sure 
your feelings will reach them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Reconstructing the main point. The 
extra element of handmade items is 
'heart', which translates to the time and 
effort put in."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Sweets handmade with someone in mind 
hold a value that store-bought treats 
simply can't match.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see... I have learned a great deal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, when reading an article on 
handmade goods, I questioned its premise. 
However, I have successfully resolved my 
doubts."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My understanding of Valentine's Day has 
deepened. Thank you very much for your 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, Bourbon. You done for the day? I 
just finished shopping myself~.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then we shall transition to the "regroup 
and transit" flow. Please wait a moment 
while I go change.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah. Hey, Trainer, you free?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, got ourselves a sponsor! 
Alright then, let's go, let's go~âª

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Here, the chocolate you asked for.

Tosen Jordan spread chocolates from 
various shops across the table. Then, she 
began opening them one after another.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, they're for eatin'. Ya get to eat 
rare chocolates on Valentine's, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The amount of chocolate info Jordan-san 
gathers through her friend network is 
truly massive. It's very helpful for 
picking chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to benefit from Jordan-san's 
intel as well, so I proposed a joint 
purchase. And now, we are sharing the 
chocolates we bought like this."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon said she's handpicking delicious 
friendship chocolates. I get to eat all 
kinds too, so it's like a win-win, right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Well then, itadakimasu.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Firsthand experience is the most 
reliable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... Status: "Delicious." The 
caramel flavor seems likely to be 
well-received by everyone.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mmm! This is insane! Hey, take a bite.

Encouraged by both of them, I eat the deep 
dark chocolate. The rich, characteristic 
bitterness slowly melts and spreads.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
......Status: "Surprise." ...Is this what 
Master prefers...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I had thought that chocolate was supposed 
to be sweet. To prefer bittersweet 
chocolate... is quite unexpected.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I haven't tested dark chocolate much, so 
I've determined that expanding my sample 
range is necessary. Let's try this dark 
one as well.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... Status: "Not bad." 
Slightly bitter, but sweetness is also 
present. ...How is this one?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, so like, I just thought of this. 
Isn't Bourbon just wanting to eat 
chocolate?

Was picking out Valentine's chocolates 
just an excuse? Watching Mihono Bourbon 
happily stuffing her cheeks with 
chocolate, I couldn't help but agree with 
that observation.
